description: State Buildings Sustainability Metrics is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Environmental Protection Agency. This data set lists sustainability metric data for state-owned buildings. These data are used to track state departments’ progress toward the goals mandated in Executive Order B-18-12. The metrics tracked in this set are total water use, total energy use, renewable energy generation and LEED certifications. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are Benchmarking, Buildings, Climate Change, DGS, EUI. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2019-10-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
